g.title: Porta Flumentana: site only; no standing structure (river frontage perhaps never walled)
Porta Carmentalis: standing double arch (obsolete); right passage shunned as the Porta Scelerata
Porta Triumphalis: debated ceremonial gate, opened only for triumphs (site D)
Porta Fontinalis: site only; probably removed by Trajan's cutting of the saddle
Porta Ratumena: vanished: its ground was cut away for Trajan's Forum (107-112)
Porta Sanqualis: fragmentary arch in surviving wall (Largo Magnanapoli)
Porta Salutaris: obsolete gate, standing (site D)
Porta Quirinalis: obsolete gate (site D)
Porta Collina: standing obsolete gate in the agger; Salaria and Nomentana leave here
Porta Viminalis: standing obsolete gate in the agger
Porta Esquilina: Augustan travertine triple arch, standing
Porta Querquetulana: obsolete gate (site D)
Porta Caelimontana: rebuilt as the Arch of Dolabella (AD 10), carrying the Arcus Neroniani
Porta Capena: standing obsolete gate dripping under aqueduct arches ("madida Capena")
Porta Naevia: obsolete gate (site D)
Porta Raudusculana: obsolete gate; wall remains nearby
Porta Lavernalis: obsolete gate (site C)
Porta Trigemina: standing obsolete gate between the Aventine and the river; Via Ostiensis starts here
Porta Mugonia: archaic gate of the Palatine settlement; a name and a spot, no structure
Porta Romanula: archaic gate of the Palatine settlement at the foot of the Clivus Victoriae; no structure
